metadata_scope: Public summary of the approved image set; private selection paths and device records are excluded.

runtime_approval.evidence: Recorded normal Android gameplay and offline save/restart checks were accepted with the limitations in docs/NATIVE_QA.json. This is dated local verification; production, physical-device, audible-audio and interactive-browser acceptance is not claimed.

captures.game_state: Normal Resort mountain map and navigation with its genuine current-session runs and saved economy. Outer menu scrolling exposes the map tools and Ski Now action.
captures.visual_review: Actual framebuffer inspected: readable intended content and accessible controls with no notification, ANR, fullscreen ad or modal obstruction. Logical tablet viewports remain labeled as emulation.
